title: Re-implementing Cross-Cutting Security Concerns inside Individual Handlers
pattern: A system manually duplicates authentication, authorization, request logging, or throttling checks inside every individual service handler or business function.
why_bad: High redundancy and prone to human error. A developer adding a new handler can easily forget to include the checks, or implement them inconsistently, creating severe security and reliability gaps.
detection: Manual replication of authentication/logging functions across multiple separate handler entry-points.
counterexample: One-off custom validation checks unique to a single endpoint. Marked `Context-dependent`.
source: Google SRE, *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (2020), Chapter 6, "Breaking Down Complexity", p. 103, 110-111.
